My dearest Cing,

If you're reading this, it means you've made it all the way through my silly little surprise hahahaha. And yes, I was smiling while making every part of it.

I just wanted to remind you that you are one of the most beautiful things that has ever happened to me Cingg. You make the ordinary days feel special, and even the little moments with you mean more than you know.

And Cing, I know how tiring your days can be. I know there are times when work takes so much out of you, but I hope you never forget how proud I am of you. You spend so much of your time taking care of others, and I hope you know that you deserve to be taken care of, too. I may not always be there to make your exhausting days easier, but I hope that even in the smallest ways, I can be someone who makes your world feel a little lighter. If I could give you flowers every single day, I would. But until then, here's a bouquet that never fades, and a reminder that my love for you isn't going anywhere.

I love you. Today, tomorrow, and in all the little tomorrows after that. ♡
